title: BD / Pre Sales Associate

About Us
Humansoff.com is an AI Automation company helping businesses automate sales, customer support, and operations using AI-powered systems. We work with startups, agencies, healthcare businesses, and service companies to help them grow faster with automation.
Role Overview
We're looking for motivated individuals who enjoy communicating with people and want hands-on experience in sales and business development. You'll be responsible for reaching out to potential clients, starting conversations, qualifying leads, and booking meetings for our team.
Key Responsibilities


Reach out to potential clients via calls, email, LinkedIn, and other outreach channels.


Introduce our AI automation solutions in a professional manner.


Qualify leads and schedule meetings with interested prospects.
